import Base

type Node is Data:
  Node{children: List<&2, Node>}

def count(node: Node) -> Nat:
  match node:
    case Node{Nil{}}: 1n
    case Node{h <> t}: Nat.add(count(h), count(Node{t}))

runtime_index_probe_source:
import Base

type Node is Data:
  Node{children: List<&2, Node>}

type Sort is Data:
  ValueSort{}
  ArraySort{}

def Payload(sort: Sort) -> Data:
  match sort:
    case ValueSort{}: Node
    case ArraySort{}: List<&2, Node>

def count(sort: Sort, piece: Payload(sort)) -> Nat:
  match sort:
    case ValueSort{}:
      match piece:
        case Node{children}: count(ArraySort{}, children)
    case ArraySort{}:
      match piece:
        case Nil{}: 0n
        case h <> t: Nat.add(count(ValueSort{}, h), count(ArraySort{}, t))

import Base

type Node is Data:
  Node{children: List<&2, Node>}

type Sort is Data:
  ValueSort{}
  ArraySort{}

def Payload(sort: Sort) -> Data:
  match sort:
    case ValueSort{}: Node
    case ArraySort{}: List<&2, Node>

def count(-sort: Sort, piece: Payload(sort)) -> Nat:
  match sort:
    case ValueSort{}:
      match piece:
        case Node{children}: count(ArraySort{}, children)
    case ArraySort{}:
      match piece:
        case Nil{}: 0n
        case h <> t: Nat.add(count(ValueSort{}, h), count(ArraySort{}, t))
